title: SQL Expense Ledger with Grouped Balances
instructions: Implement `create_tables`, `add_expense`, `record_payment`, `balances` and `history` in `ledger_sql.py` using `sqlite3`. `add_expense` must validate paid-equals-owed and write the expense plus its rows in one transaction. `balances` must be a single grouped SQL query, and payments flow through it as ordinary expenses.

evidence.label: Balances come from SQL and settlements reduce them with no special case
Unbalanced or one-sided expenses raise ValueError and write nothing
A database failure part-way rolls back the expense row too
Balances can be restricted to one group or cover all groups
History lists the user's rows ordered by expense then row id
A payment from a user to themselves is rejected
SQL balances match a Python computation on random data and sum to zero
create_tables can be run again without losing data
Stores the paid total and tags payments as PAYMENT, with group ids
